component.name: PlaylistTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "loadPlaylist" end sub
sub loadPlaylist() m.top.errorMessage = "" response = fetchText(m.top.uri) if response.error <> "" m.top.errorMessage = response.error return end if
playlistType = m.top.playlistType.lcase() if playlistType = "" playlistType = extensionFromUrl(m.top.uri) end if
if playlistType = "server-random" playlist = parseServerPlaylist(response.body) else if playlistType = "pls" playlist = parsePls(response.body) else if playlistType = "m3u" or playlistType = "m3u8" playlist = parseM3u(response.body) else m.top.errorMessage = "Unsupported playlist type: " + playlistType return end if
if playlist.getChildCount() = 0 m.top.errorMessage = "The selected channel playlist contains no playable entries." return end if m.top.playlist = playlist end sub
function fetchText(uri as string) as object transfer = createObject("roUrlTransfer") transfer.setCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") transfer.initClientCertificates() transfer.setUrl(uri) port = createObject("roMessagePort") transfer.setMessagePort(port)
if not transfer.asyncGetToString() return { body: "", error: "The playlist request could not be started." } end if
timeoutSeconds = m.top.timeoutSeconds if timeoutSeconds <= 0 then timeoutSeconds = 15 event = wait(timeoutSeconds * 1000, port) if event = invalid transfer.asyncCancel() return { body: "", error: "The playlist server did not respond within " + timeoutSeconds.toStr() + " seconds." } end if if type(event) <> "roUrlEvent" transfer.asyncCancel() return { body: "", error: "The playlist server returned an unexpected network event." } end if
body = event.getString() code = event.getResponseCode()
if code < 200 or code >= 300 return { body: "", error: "Playlist request failed with HTTP " + code.toStr() + "." } end if if body = "" then return { body: "", error: "The playlist response was empty." } return { body: body, error: "" } end function
function parseServerPlaylist(text as string) as object playlist = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") envelope = ParseJson(text) if type(envelope) <> "roAssociativeArray" then return playlist if not envelope.doesExist("items") or type(envelope.items) <> "roArray" then return playlist
for index = 0 to envelope.items.count() - 1 item = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") item.addFields({ resolveUrl: m.top.resolverUri }) item.title = "Shuffled program " + (index + 1).toStr() playlist.appendChild(item) end for return playlist end function
function parseM3u(text as string) as object playlist = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") pendingTitle = "" lines = text.split(chr(10)) for each rawLine in lines line = cleanLine(rawLine) if line.left(8).ucase() = "#EXTINF:" comma = instr(1, line, ",") if comma > 0 then pendingTitle = line.mid(comma) else if line <> "" and line.left(1) <> "#" appendEntry(playlist, line, pendingTitle) pendingTitle = "" end if end for return playlist end function
function parsePls(text as string) as object playlist = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") files = {} titles = {} maxIndex = 0
for each rawLine in text.split(chr(10)) line = cleanLine(rawLine) equalsAt = instr(1, line, "=") if equalsAt > 1 key = line.left(equalsAt - 1).lcase() value = line.mid(equalsAt) if key.left(4) = "file" index = key.mid(4).toInt() files[index.toStr()] = value if index > maxIndex then maxIndex = index else if key.left(5) = "title" index = key.mid(5).toInt() titles[index.toStr()] = value end if end if end for
for index = 1 to maxIndex key = index.toStr() if files.doesExist(key) title = "" if titles.doesExist(key) then title = titles[key] appendEntry(playlist, files[key], title) end if end for return playlist end function
sub appendEntry(parent as object, url as string, title as string) item = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") item.addFields({ resolveUrl: "" }) item.url = resolveEntryUrl(url) item.title = title if item.title = "" then item.title = "Playlist item " + (parent.getChildCount() + 1).toStr() item.streamFormat = mediaFormat(url) item.httpCertificatesFile = "common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt" parent.appendChild(item) end sub
function resolveEntryUrl(value as string) as string entryUrl = cleanLine(value) lowerUrl = entryUrl.lcase() if lowerUrl.left(7) = "http://" or lowerUrl.left(8) = "https://" then return entryUrl
baseUrl = m.top.uri if entryUrl.left(2) = "//" schemeParts = baseUrl.split(":") if schemeParts.count() > 0 then return schemeParts[0] + ":" + entryUrl end if
baseParts = baseUrl.split("/") if entryUrl.left(1) = "/" and baseParts.count() >= 3 return baseParts[0] + "//" + baseParts[2] + entryUrl end if
queryAt = instr(1, baseUrl, "?") if queryAt > 0 then baseUrl = baseUrl.left(queryAt - 1) fragmentAt = instr(1, baseUrl, "#") if fragmentAt > 0 then baseUrl = baseUrl.left(fragmentAt - 1) for index = len(baseUrl) to 1 step -1 if baseUrl.mid(index - 1, 1) = "/" return baseUrl.left(index) + entryUrl end if end for return entryUrl end function
function mediaFormat(url as string) as string extension = extensionFromUrl(url) if extension = "m3u8" then return "hls" if extension = "mpd" then return "dash" if extension = "ism" or extension = "isml" then return "ism" if extension = "" then return "mp4" return extension end function
function extensionFromUrl(url as string) as string cleanUrl = url queryAt = instr(1, cleanUrl, "?") if queryAt > 0 then cleanUrl = cleanUrl.left(queryAt - 1) fragmentAt = instr(1, cleanUrl, "#") if fragmentAt > 0 then cleanUrl = cleanUrl.left(fragmentAt - 1) dotAt = 0 for index = len(cleanUrl) to 1 step -1 if cleanUrl.mid(index - 1, 1) = "." dotAt = index exit for end if if cleanUrl.mid(index - 1, 1) = "/" then exit for end for if dotAt = 0 then return "" return cleanUrl.mid(dotAt).lcase() end function
function cleanLine(value as string) as string return value.replace(chr(13), "").trim() end function
